name: memoization
context: Repeated identical or near-identical LLM and tool calls: results are cached, keyed by normalized input, model, and parameters, to cut cost and latency.
tradeoffs: Cache key normalization is tricky for semantic caches
avoid_when: Responses must always reflect the absolute latest state of external data
design_principles: Include model_id, system_prompt_hash, tenant_id, and language in cache keys
best_practices: Use two tiers: exact then semantic
Pin cache entries per model version
Use similarity thresholds by workload: FAQ (0.85-0.93), Code (0.94-0.97+)
Validate cached answers on borderline similarity scores (0.85-0.94)
Use TTL jitter to prevent thundering herd on expiry
Place guardrails before cache to filter PII and detect prompt injection
references: Komal et al., GPTCache: A Semantic Cache for Building Practical Chatbot Systems, NLP-OSS 2023 — https://aclanthology.org/2023.nlposs-1.4/
